spec_family.name: New Construction Drywall Wall Prime Coat
spec_family.description: Prime coat application for bare drywall wall surfaces in new construction. Covers walls only (prime coat, no finish coats). Drywall is assumed taped, mudded, and sanded by drywall contractor. Does NOT include ceiling prime, trim prime, or finish coat application.

includes: Bare drywall wall surfaces (taped, mudded, sanded)
excludes: Drywall repair beyond normal joint compound coverage
Stain blocking for smoke/water damage (use repaint spec)

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier governing prep intensity, material grade, and edge discipline
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT5 unlikely for prime-only scope; QT2 is minimal economy work
Spray+backroll most common in NC production; roll for smaller jobs; spray-only for speed where backroll not required

configuration_dimensions.description: Drywall finish level per GA-214 standard
configuration_dimensions.notes: Level 3 = tape/compound only; Level 4 = additional skim coat; Level 5 = skim coat entire surface

configuration_dimensions.description: Wall surface texture (if applied before priming)
configuration_dimensions.notes: Texture affects coverage rate and application technique

paintable_items.name: Wall Field Prime Coat
paintable_items.counting_rules: Source from PaintScope PS_SURFACE_SF.WALL_FIELD; covers all paintable wall area excluding openings
paintable_items.notes: Primary item for wall priming scope

paintable_items.name: Ceiling Edge Cut-In
paintable_items.counting_rules: Source from PaintScope PS_EDGE_LF.TO_CEILING; wall-to-ceiling boundary requiring brush cut-in
paintable_items.notes: Required when spray method used or ceiling done on separate schedule

variants.notes: Minimal economy roller application - edge work not separated
Standard quality roller application with edge cut-in
Premium roller application with crisp edge work
Standard production spray+backroll with edge cut-in
Premium spray+backroll with attention to edge discipline
Economy spray-only, no backroll, edge work not separated
Standard spray-only where backroll not required

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Total paintable wall field area (excluding openings)
Linear footage of wall-to-ceiling edge for cut-in work

site_condition_rules.affects: Floor protection tasks — rosin paper on hard floors, canvas/plastic on carpet

research_corrections.title: No spot-priming NC drywall fasteners
research_corrections.impact: Removed TSK_SPOT_PRIME_FASTENERS task and all spot-prime references

research_corrections.title: PVA/acrylic drywall primers have zero stain blocking
research_corrections.impact: Removed stain blocking claims from materials and research

research_corrections.title: Do not specify dry times in specs
research_corrections.impact: Removed dry time references from research and materials

change_log.changes: Initial draft spec family for NC drywall wall priming

change_log.author: DevOrchestrator
change_log.changes: Applied RC-001 through RC-004 corrections: removed spot-priming task and references, removed stain blocking claims, added floor_type site condition, removed dry time references. Replaced non-top-tier brands with SW/BM/PPG. Fixed tape yield (180 LF/roll), masking paper yield (180 LF/roll). Updated roller covers to 18-inch for spray_backroll. Applied universal application quality doctrine to all quality_notes.
